module: Settings and settings window of the screenshot/thumbnail creator. It keeps all the settings in ImGui pointers (getControls): output destination, resolution (presets thumbnail 800x448, 720p, 1080p, 4k, 8k…), supersampling, FOV, camera height, framing margins, dynamic reflection quality, exposure, low beams, settle delay, physics freeze, lighting rig, SSAO. It builds the contexts (getFramingContext, getCaptureContext, getJobSettings) consumed by job.lua, the framing modes and the capture, applies/restores the showroom environment (local exposure, reflections, plates, seat occupants) and draws the margin overlays in the 3D view.
notes: Default values: destination "Vehicle thumbnails" (vehicles/), resolution 800x448, supersampling 3, FOV 20, camera height 1.1 m, horizontal margin 32 px, manual exposure 8.3 EV, Ultra reflections, settle delay 2 s, physics frozen, shipped configs only.
ctrls.resolution is a preset index with 0 = "custom"; UI indices go from 1 to 9 (getResolutions is 1-based). outputDestination and selectedMargin are 0-based.

Safety margins are defined for the 500x281 reference resolution (targets tiny, small, medium, large, huge, list, minimal) then scaled (scaleMargin). The "minimal" target is the maximum of all the others. The default index safeMargins.defaultTargetIndex is 6, which designates the 7th target ("minimal") since getMarginTarget adds 1.

applyEnvironment, applyReflections and applyLicensePlates act only in the showroom_v2_lighting and showroom_v2_lighting_simple levels; elsewhere they do nothing (applyReflections/applyLicensePlates return false). Fixed exposure is applied only in the showroom.

The original environment (plates, VariableRegistry dynamic reflections, PostEffectLocalExposureObject exposure, seat occupants) is stored at the first applyEnvironment and restored by restoreEnvironment/finishWork; if restoration fails, the stored state is kept.
applyLowBeams turns on the lights only if enabled is true; it never turns them off.
Minor inconsistency: the "Procedural camera height" slider is described as "height above the lowest enabled node", whereas framing/procedural places the rail at groundHeight + cameraHeight.

deserialize accepts old states (resolutionPtr, selectedCameraOverlayMargin, cameraCompositionOverlayEnabled, dynamicReflectionsEnabled) and migrates the old reflection quality numbering (serialization version 2).

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: ui_imgui and core_camera.

getControls.desc: Returns the table of all ImGui pointers of the settings (outputDestination, resolution, imageResolution, superSampling, fieldOfView, cameraHeight, selectedMargin, lightRoleIntensity, etc.). Modifying these pointers directly modifies the settings.

getOutputControls.desc: Returns the subset of output pointers: outputDestination, resolution, imageResolution, shippedConfigsOnly, keepAspectRatio, resolutionMultiplier.

getRenderControls.desc: Returns the render pointers: superSampling, shippedConfigsOnly, fieldOfView, cameraHeight, dynamicReflectionQuality, lowBeamsEnabled, settleDelay, freezePhysics, autoExposure, manualExposure.

getDefaults.desc: Returns a copy of the settings' default values.

getThumbnailConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the thumbnail config: {fileEnding = ".jpg", fov = 20, nearPlane = 0.1}.

getFramingDefaults.desc: Returns a copy of the framing defaults: {cameraAxisDownOffset = 0.10, cameraHeight = 1.1, settleDelay = 1}.

getOutputDestinations.desc: Returns the names of the output destinations: "Vehicle thumbnails" and "Screenshot/showroom folder".

getResolutions.desc: Returns the resolution presets {name, width, height}.

getSafeMargins.desc: Returns the safety margin definition: {width = 500, height = 281, defaultTargetIndex, targets = [{name, left, right, top, bottom, extraBottom, color}]}.

getVehicleSafeMargin.desc: Returns the extra margin around the vehicle: {top = 4, bottom = 2} (in reference pixels).

getDynamicReflectionQualities.desc: Returns the reflection quality levels: Lowest, Low, Normal, High, Ultra.

getThumbnailResolution.desc: Returns the correct resolution of a vehicle thumbnail ("thumbnail" preset, 800 x 448).

getCurrentResolution.desc: Returns the final chosen resolution: that of the selected preset, or the custom resolution if "custom".

setImageResolution.desc: Sets the custom resolution (rounded, minimum 1) and selects the matching preset if there is one, otherwise "custom".

getMarginTarget.desc: Returns the margin target of the given index (0-based). The "minimal" target is replaced by the maximum of all the others. Falls back to the default target if the index is invalid.

returns.desc: {name, left, right, top, bottom, extraBottom, color} in 500x281 reference pixels.

addVehicleMargin.desc: Adds to a margin target the horizontal margin set by the user (left and right) and the vehicle margins (top +4, bottom +2).

returns.desc: New margin, or nil if margin is nil.

scaleMargin.desc: Scales a margin expressed for 500x281 to the given resolution.

returns.desc: Margin in pixels of the target resolution (returned as is if an argument is missing).

getFramingMargin.desc: Computes the final framing margin for a resolution: chosen target + vehicle margins, scaled. Returns a zero margin if "useFramingMargins" is unchecked.

getFramingContext.desc: Builds the context passed to the framing modes: fieldOfView/fov, nearPlane, cameraHeight, cameraAxisDownOffset, settleDelay, resolution, aspectRatio, useMargins, margin and debug {drawBounds, drawOobb, drawInputs}. The caller adds vehicle, configName, etc.

getCaptureContext.desc: Builds the capture context: destination, file extension, resolution, superSampling (and supersampling), internalResolution (resolution × supersampling), reflection quality, lights, delay, physics freeze, exposure, sample/comparison options.

getJobSettings.desc: Merges the framing and capture contexts into a single table of job settings (outputFolder, resolution, fov, margin, captureTimeout min 0.1 s…). Options override some UI settings.

options.desc: {resolution, outputFolder, lowBeamsEnabled, shippedConfigsOnly, sample, comparison, captureTimeout}.

getLightingRig.desc: Returns the lighting rig settings read from the UI: enabled, exposureCorrection, ssaoMode ("on", "reduced" or "off"), parkingMarkup, roles[id] = {intensity, shadows} for key, fill, rim, top, groundFill, horizonFill.

drawLightingControls.desc: Draws the lighting ImGui controls: cyclorama color (showroom_v2_lighting_backdrop material), camera-relative rig, shadows and intensity per role, exposure correction, parking markup, SSAO mode.

drawOutputControls.desc: Draws the output ImGui controls: "Restore thumbnail defaults" button, destination, procedural FOV and camera height, horizontal margin, resolutions, supersampling, reflections, exposure, lights, settle delay, physics freeze, and an image size summary.

options.desc: {drawToggleUiApps = function} drawn next to the resolution preview button.

drawOverlayControls.desc: Draws the overlay ImGui controls: margins, framing box, OOBB, framing inputs, composition, as well as the Sample and Comparison checkboxes.

drawCameraOverlay.desc: Draws in the 3D view, in front of the current camera, the frame of the final image (red), the safety margins (green), the vehicle margins (blue) and optionally the composition grid (thirds and center). To be called every frame.

fovOverride.desc: FOV in degrees to use instead of the set FOV.

isDefaultConfig.desc: Indicates whether the main output/render settings are at the thumbnail default values.

isThumbnailConfigGood.desc: Checks that, for the "Vehicle thumbnails" destination, the resolution is indeed the thumbnail preset.

returns.desc: false if the size is not suitable for game thumbnails.

resetToDefaults.desc: Resets the output and render settings to their default values (not those of the lighting or the overlays).

setPreviewResolution.desc: Switches the game window to borderless mode at the final chosen resolution (preview), or restores the original video mode.

applyExposure.desc: Writes the exposure (auto or manual in EV) to the scene's PostEffectLocalExposureObject.

returns.desc: true if the object exists and took the requested values.

applyReflections.desc: Applies the chosen dynamic reflection quality via dynCaptureQuality (showroom only).

applyEnvironment.desc: Stores the current environment then applies that of the captures: exposure, reflections, ungenerated plates, seat occupants disabled. Does nothing outside the showroom.

options.desc: {applyExposure = false} to leave the exposure untouched.

getEnvironmentSnapshot.desc: Returns a copy of the stored environment (skipLicensePlates, dynamicReflectionRuntime, autoExposure, manualExposure, seatOccupants).

returns.desc: Snapshot, nil if nothing was stored.

applyEnvironmentSnapshot.desc: Reapplies an environment snapshot while checking each value; logs an error for each setting not restored.

restoreEnvironment.desc: Restores the stored environment then forgets it.

returns.desc: true if everything is restored or if nothing had been stored.

beginWork.desc: Start of a capture job: calls applyEnvironment.

finishWork.desc: End of a capture job: calls restoreEnvironment.

applyLowBeams.desc: Turns on the vehicle's low beams (electrics.setLightsState(1)) if enabled; does nothing otherwise.

enabled.desc: Imposed value; by default the UI setting.

serialize.desc: Returns all the settings as a serializable table (alias onSerialize).

deserialize.desc: Restores the settings from a table (clamped values, old formats accepted), then applies exposure and reflections if in the showroom (alias onDeserialized).

data.desc: Serialized state; ignored if it is not a table.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before extension reload; identical to serialize.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload with the serialized state; identical to deserialize.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: resets the settings to default and applies the environment (showroom).

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook called after a level starts: in the showroom, forces reflections to Ultra and applies the environment.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: restores the window resolution if the preview was active, then restores the environment. Also used as onClientEndMission and onExit.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-level hook; same function as onExtensionUnloaded.

onExit.desc: Game close hook; same function as onExtensionUnloaded.
